page_title: PAU 0-2 WER | St. Pauli v Werder Bremen 14/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' We are about to witness a subsitution. Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen) for Romano Schmid.
90+4' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
90+2' The referee allows time for a substitution. Danel Sinani will be replaced by Erik Ahlstrand (St. Pauli).
90+1' Substitution. Carlo Boukhalfa will be replaced by Maurides Roque Junior (St. Pauli).
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' St. Pauli string together a series of short passes.
87' The corner is swung in but Werder Bremen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
85' Substitution. Derrick Kohn makes his way off the pitch and Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) comes on as his replacement.
85' Substitution. Niklas Stark makes way for Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen).
83' Here is a change. Johannes Eggestein is going off and Alexander Blessin gives the last tactical orders to Maurides Roque Junior (St. Pauli).
83' Alexander Blessin decides to make a substitution. Johannes Eggestein will be replaced by Andreas Nielsen Albers (St. Pauli).
78' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
76' Alexander Blessin has decided to make a change. Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) replaces Manolis Saliakas.
75' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) receives a nice pass from the free kick and strikes from the edge of the box, but his attempt hits one of the defenders and bounces away off him.

74' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Eric Smith (St. Pauli) is going to have a crack himself.
70' The resulting corner, taken by Eric Smith (St. Pauli), comes to nothing.
70' Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marco Grull.
69' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but Michael Zetterer was alert and made a comfortable save.
67' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
65' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Hartmann had an easy-decision to make.
59' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
56' 0 - 2 Goal! Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:2.
56' The ball is out of play. St. Pauli win a corner kick.
55' The attendance is 29546.
54' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
49' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
49' The match can continue after the interruption.
48' The game is interrupted.
47' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Niklas Stark, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
43' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) was quite harsh and Robert Hartmann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
42' A corner kick by Werder Bremen is thwarted by the well prepared Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli).
42' The resulting set piece from Werder Bremen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Werder Bremen can continue in their attacking effort.
41' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Nikola Vasilj has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
38' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) takes the corner which is cleared.

37' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to St. Pauli.
37' Werder Bremen play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass.
33' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
29' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) attempts to feed Marvin Ducksch with a chip pass, but Nikola Vasilj reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
28' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for St. Pauli.
24' 0 - 1 Goal! Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.

22' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
21' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) sends a cross in and finds Johannes Eggestein inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
19' St. Pauli take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

18' A snap shot by Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Michael Zetterer produces a good save to thwart him. St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
17' Good defending. Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) tries to find Oladapo Afolayan inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
12' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
11' One of the players from Werder Bremen times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
8' Robert Hartmann shows a yellow card to Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) for his blatant foul.
6' Werder Bremen keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
2' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) gets inside the box and tries to beat Nikola Vasilj with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! St. Pauli will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Robert Hartmann.
